# Refund Policy

**tags:** payments, policy, en
**source:** https://wiki.example.com/payments/refund
**anchor:** refund-policy

---

We refund within 14 days of purchase. To request a refund, contact support
with your order number and reason for the refund.

Refunds are processed back to the original payment method and typically
take 3-5 business days to appear on your statement.
